facts.fact: The Ministry of Home Affairs, Immigration, Safety and Security says its e-birth notification system, which electronically notifies the e-NPRS of births, was implemented at 22 named hospitals and health centres in 2019/2020.
The Ministry says its e-death notification system, electronic notification of deaths in line with births, was implemented at 26 named sites in 2019/2020.

facts.fact: The Ministry says its mandate is to manage the National Population Register and that the National Population Registration System (NPRS, e-NPRS) holds ID application records and verifies them.
The Ministry says the e-birth notification system electronically notifies the e-NPRS of a birth and captures the child's birth details, and deaths are notified electronically in line with births.
The Ministry says the e-birth notification system verifies the mother's identity against the NPRS.
